pythonFunction.name: validate_authentication_otp
pythonFunction.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP code provided by the caller. If the code is invalid or consists of repeated digits (like 000000, 111111, 222222, 333333, etc.), returns auth_status 'Fail' and decrements attempts_remaining (starts at 3, decrements to 2, 1, 0). If valid, returns auth_status 'Pass'.
